settings.text: You have questions? We have answers.

settings.title: When is the best time to take DIGESTIVE+++?
settings.content: DIGESTIVE+++ is best taken one to two times daily about 15 minutes before meal time

settings.title: How many DIGESTIVE+++ softgels should I take?
settings.content: The suggested usage for DIGESTIVE+++ is 1 to 2 softgels daily.

settings.title: Does DIGESTIVE+++ need to be refrigerated?
settings.content: DIGESTIVE+++ is best kept in a cool, dry place, but it does not need to be refrigerated.

settings.title: How many softgels are in each bottle of DIGESTIVE+++?
Are there any adverse reactions for DIGESTIVE+++?
settings.content: There are no documented cases of adverse reactions to DIGESTIVE+++. When taken as recommended, DIGESTIVE+++ is safe and effective.

settings.title: What if I already take another prebiotic, probiotic and/or digestive enzyme supplement?
settings.content: DIGESTIVE+++ offers a superior Probiotic that is fueled by a potent and natural Prebiotic Blend, in addition to essential digestive enzymes for maximum nutrient absorption, eliminating the need for three separate supplements*

settings.title: What is the difference between a probiotic and a prebiotic?
settings.content:
Probiotics are living, beneficial bacteria that help to maintain the good bacteria in the intestinal tract that are key to keeping the

 large intestine healthy. Prebiotics are non-living food ingredients that fuel the probiotic to help good bacteria grow.

settings.title: Isn’t bacteria bad for you?
settings.content: When it comes to your large intestine, there are “good” or healthy bacteria, such as probiotics, and “bad” or pathogenic bacteria, which can cause a multitude of health issues. Probiotics are the “good” bacteria that are essential to maintaining intestinal health

settings.title: Why are there three different Proteases in DIGESTIVE+++
settings.content: Proteases are digestive enzymes that help to digest proteins. As with carbohydrates and sugars, there are different types of proteinsthat come from different sources. So, we need different proteases to help digest the variety of proteins that we consume.Additionally, Laminine is composed of proteins and added Proteases can allow Laminine to be absorbed better in the body*

settings.title: What if I already have a well-functioning digestive system?
settings.content: Issues associated with the digestive system are often difficult to recognize until they turn into something more serious. That’s why it is important to take the steps necessary to maintain good digestive health throughout our lifetime.

settings.title: Can I take this product with other medications/prescriptions?
settings.content: DIGESTIVE+++ is a safe and natural dietary supplement. When taken as recommended, it is safe and effective. Any questions about how DIGESTIVE+++ will interact with other medications you take should be addressed by your personal physician.

settings.title: For how long do I need to take DIGESTIVE+++ before I notice results?
settings.content: The effects of DIGESTIVE+++ will vary by individual. Some may feel positive benefits in a short period of time and others may have to take the product longer to notice a change.

settings.title: Is there such a thing as taking too many enzymes?
settings.content: Digestive enzymes do not accumulate in the body, and therefore only stay in the body for a short period of time, which is why it is important to constantly replenish the enzymes.
